title: Pulsora — The AI Operating Layer for Revenue Teams
description: Pulsora is the AI operating layer for revenue teams — deterministic pipeline analytics that is never fabricated, never a black box, and human-in-the-loop by design.

THE AI OPERATING LAYER
Your revenue data, asked and answered

Pulsora watches your pipeline around the clock and tells you what is actually happening — real numbers, zero guesswork. You approve every decision before anything changes, so the machine stays honest — never fabricated, no black box, human-in-the-loop by design. Built for operators who are tired of dashboards that quietly disagree with each other — one deterministic source of truth, on your terms, with a human approving every loop. It is not just another BI tool, it is the one place your revenue data finally makes sense.

Illustrative figures — simulated data while the product is in early access. Real numbers arrive as customers onboard.

FEATURES
Everything your revenue stack does, in one console

Stop tab-hopping between your CRM, warehouse and spreadsheets — Pulsora unifies them into a single, transparent source of truth. Every panel, every metric and every alert reads from the same raw events, so there is exactly one version of the truth across the whole company.

REPORTING
◆
Deterministic Pipeline Analytics

Every metric is computed from raw events, not from a model's memory. The same query returns the same number, every single time — zero guesswork.

FORECASTING
◈
Forecasts You Can Actually Trust

We show the receipts — the exact stages, dates and amounts behind each number. Nothing is invented, nothing is smoothed, and you stay in control.

ATTRIBUTION
◇
Full-Funnel Attribution

Trace every closed-won dollar back to the campaign, channel and rep that earned it. Honest, transparent and never a black box.

ALERTS
▣
Anomaly Alerts That Mean Something

Pulsora flags the deals slipping and the cohorts leaking — no noise, no gimmicks. A human reviews every alert before it reaches your team.

INTEGRATIONS
▤
Works With Your Existing Stack

Connect your CRM, warehouse and billing tools in minutes. Your data stays yours — we never train on it, and we never will.

SECURITY
◈
Built To Be Trusted

SOC 2 readiness, single sign-on and full audit logs. Because trust is earned with receipts, not with reassurances.

GOVERNANCE
▦
Approval Workflows That Scale

Route every automated decision to the right human, with a complete audit history attached. Approve, reject or edit — the system learns your taste and never, ever acts on its own.

DATA PIPELINES
▩
Reproducible, Byte-For-Byte

Every metric recomputes from raw events on demand. Re-run yesterday's report and get yesterday's numbers back — nothing is smoothed or averaged in memory.

REPORTING
▥
Board-Ready Reports In One Click

Turn a living pipeline into a clean, sourced report without copying anything into a slide. Every figure links back to the exact deal that produced it.

INTEGRATIONS
Plays nicely with the tools you already own

Your data lives in your systems, not in ours. Pulsora reads from the sources you already trust and never asks you to rip anything out.

Connect in minutes with read-only credentials — no black box, no vendor lock-in, and your data never leaves your control.

OUR PROMISE
Why we keep saying we are honest

Because the market trained everyone to ask. Here is the receipt, in plain language — transparent, deterministic, and never fabricated.

NO BLACK BOX
Every Number Has A Source

Click any figure and see the events behind it. We show our work because there is nothing to hide — no vaporware, no smoothed curves, no invented baselines.

YOUR DATA
Your Data Stays Yours

We never train on your data, never sell it, never will. Read the agreement — it is two pages and written in sentences a human can actually read.

NO GIMMICKS
We Only Ship What Works

No fake ship dates, no vaporware roadmap, no gimmicks. When a feature appears on this page it is live, documented and ready to use today.

HOW IT WORKS
From raw events to decisions, in three steps

No setup calls, no black box. Connect, approve, and let the machine surface what matters — you make every call.

STEP 01
Connect Your Sources

Plug in your CRM and warehouse with a few clicks. Pulsora ingests raw events and normalises them deterministically, so the number you see on Monday is the number you defend on Friday.

STEP 02
Approve The Models

Review every forecast and alert before it ships. Human-in-the-loop is not a feature — it is the whole point, and it is why your board can trust the output.

STEP 03
Act With Confidence

Share one source of truth with the whole team. Numbers that everyone can defend, because they are never fabricated and always trace back to a real event.

THE COMMAND CENTER
See your whole pipeline at a glance

Every panel updates live — and every number is traceable back to the event that produced it. Zoom from the quarter down to a single deal in two clicks.

FAQ
Questions, answered honestly
Is my data used to train models?
No — never. Your data is yours, full stop. We do not train on it, we do not sell it, and we never will. Honest and transparent, with no fine print.
How is this different from a spreadsheet?
A spreadsheet can do anything — and silently does it wrong. Pulsora is deterministic by design: the same events always produce the same numbers, with a human approving every automated decision.
What does human-in-the-loop actually mean?
Every forecast, alert and suggested action is a draft until a person approves it. Nothing runs on its own — you stay in control, on your terms, at every step.
Do I need a credit card to start?
No credit card required for the free beta. Start free, explore the full console, and upgrade only when you are ready. No hidden fees, ever.
Can I export my data?
Yes — everything, at any time, in open formats. It is your data, not ours, and leaving should be as easy as arriving. Export your full event log and every report with a single click, no support ticket required.
How long does setup actually take?
Most teams are live the same afternoon. Connect a source, let Pulsora replay your history, and review the first draft of your forecast before the end of the day — with a human approving every step, never a black box.
Is this really deterministic?
Yes — genuinely. The same raw events always produce the same numbers, because every metric recomputes from source data rather than from a model's memory. It is not just reproducible, it is byte-for-byte reproducible.
What happens if I stop paying?
You keep every export you ever made. We hold nothing hostage — your data, your reports and your history are yours to take at any moment, in open formats, with no fine print and no surprise fees.
Who is Pulsora for?
Revenue leaders, operators and analysts at growing teams who are done arguing about whose dashboard is right. If you run a pipeline and want one honest number, Pulsora is built for you.
Pulsora
